title: OpenAI Prepares for Massive New Funding Round
excerpt: OpenAI is reportedly planning a new $30 billion funding round ahead of an IPO, aiming for a valuation of $1.25 trillion.
body_html:
OpenAI is currently working on a new funding round aiming to raise $30 billion, according to recent reports. If successful, the company would target a valuation of $1.25 trillion.

This massive financial move is taking place ahead of an anticipated initial public offering. Achieving a valuation exceeding $1 trillion would establish a new record, making it the most highly valued private company in history.
